1.name: Recuperative Treatise
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3798|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6701|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff2959|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3037|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10449|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Resolving Vigor
4.description:
Let loose a battle cry, instilling yourself with resolve and healing for |cffffff15948|r Health over |cffffff5|r seconds.

After casting you gain Minor Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff2974|r, for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Relentless Focus
5.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff13675|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

6.name: Replenishing Barrier
6.description:
Invoke defensive tactics to protect yourself and nearby group members with wards that each absorb up to |cffffff38704|r damage. 

Each time a ward dissolves, you restore |cffffff1500|r Magicka.
